title: Silverlight Research Publishes Global Expert Network Landscape 2026 Index
summary: Silverlight Research published its institutional index covering leading global expert networks including GLG, AlphaSights, Third Bridge, Guidepoint, Capvision, Atheneum, and VisasQ, with detailed profiles on compliance, coverage, and operating models.
whyItMatters: Silverlight's annual landscape report provides one of the most detailed competitive analyses of the expert network industry, informing buyer decisions.
